body: claim_key_package has no relationship check and no rate limit: any authenticated user can GET /mls/key-packages/:user_id in a loop and permanently consume a target's whole KeyPackage pool (claims are single-use, irreversible). Every legitimate peer then gets 404 'No available KeyPackage' and E2EE establishment with that user is denied until their device tops up. Also discloses deviceId to any caller. NOT FIXED — needs a per-claimer cap or a contact/DM-exists precondition.
author: Vibe Team
